name: did-auth-keygen
description: Generates the P-256 key pairs of the DID Auth demo: one for the server and one for the client. Public demo keys only.

nodes.label: Server Key Pair
nodes.note:
# Server key pair
- P-256 (secp256r1), as in the DID Auth procedure
- Public key: uncompressed point, 65 bytes starting with `04`
- Random on every run. Copy the values you want to keep into the Workflow Input defaults of the client and server workflows.

nodes.label: Client Key Pair
nodes.note:
# Client key pair
Same as the server key pair, generated independently.
